notes.title: Just 24 hours til Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick update, dropping in to let everyone know the game will be release [b]completely uncensored[/b] tomorrow at 12PM EST. The game will be $10.99, but will launch with a 10% discount that will run for one week. We hope you'll all enjoy the game! See you tomorrow for the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36200905/47e03730e991c6b27a585d1133a98c0dd5c34f05.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick update regarding the game's release. It's been a little bit, but we're happy to say that the game is currently in final build review on Steam, and we're hoping to release in the last week of the month right now. 

Some screenshots until then:
